title: BLR constraint in the distinct-query case
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $x,y$ be vectors in $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. If $x
eq 0$, $y
eq 0$, and $x
eq y$, then the constraint assigned to $(x,y)$ is the linear equation with right-hand side $0$ on the three distinct variables $x$, $y$, and $x+y$, in that order.
